ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: MIMT uses the contacts on this device to help you call and text people. They are not sent to MIMT.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MIMT uses the microphone during your calls and to record your voicemail greeting.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MIMT accesses the photos you choose to attach them to a text (MMS).
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: If you allow it, ads in the free plan can be personalised. Otherwise they stay non-personalised.
